baseline.description: Existing chronological HGB/Ridge/ExtraTrees forecast ensemble with declared fixture/venue adjustment; rerun under the same modern target/information/resources as candidates. Primary fullmanager uses common adaptive policy. Matched screening uses common inherited opening and fixed WC/FH/BB, adaptive TC. Historical benchmark scores are not reused.

candidates.hypothesis: Explicit known future-fixture evaluation from frozen current-origin player/team state improves neutral-reversion benchmark trajectories without changing its fitted coefficients/gate.
Separate play and60minute probabilities and conditional short/long scoring improve expected availability and appearance-point coherence.
Coherent expected scoring components conditional on participation improve goal/assist/clean-sheet/bonus/defensive/keeper tradeoffs.

stage_budgets.cap: Three registered configurations only; at most12 predeclared origins per configuration for schema/causality/resource tests. No candidate score rankings. Solver probes use frozen predecision inputs only. Stop and amend before broadening.

stage_budgets.configuration: Three candidates plus rerun baseline × three devseasons, work_reference only; same inherited/rescored opening and NEW common manager-origin player pool, including dated preseason membership. All four sharethisuniverse, which differs from thepriorcampaign matched pool; oldmatchedscores cannot be reused.
stage_budgets.promotion: Eligible if mean gain>=25, at least2positive seasons and no season gain<−50. Rank eligible bymean netgain, then minimum season gain, then candidate id; at most2. Prediction metrics never override scoregate. If none passes, research goal remains active and requires preregistered next amendment.

stage_budgets.configuration: At most2finalists plusbaseline ×3devseasons×3distinct workbudgets. Common emptyGW1 state/budget, same information and adaptivepolicy; independently carried state. No candidate-specific retry/budget increase.
stage_budgets.promotion: Each finalist must have mean gain>=100 in EVERY setting and strictlypositive gain in ALL9season-settingpairs.

stage_budgets.configuration: A fresh process replay/reoptimization of work_reference for baseline and at most2finalists ×3seasons. Exact input/model/action/state hashes checked; wall times need not match. Identical duplicates add ZERO independent statistical evidence.
stage_budgets.failure: Unexplained action drift blocks upgrade declaration; inspect without cherry-picking best repeat.

stage_budgets.configuration: Only after immutablefinalist/fullmanagergate/selection lock:baseline plusselectedupgrade,2025/26,work_reference. No new2025candidate scores beforelock; skip ifno candidate qualifies.
stage_budgets.selection_effect: none; report allresults including failure/regression; cannot change selectedcandidate or rescue faileddevelopmentgate.

forecast_training_budget.lock_rule: Set equal cap from outcome-free feasibility probes before S1, then no candidate-specific increase. Actual cost may differ and must be reported.

adaptive_search_controls: Append-only trialregistry records every proposed/configured/executed/failed/promoted trial with source/config/code hashes and parent hypothesis before outcomeaccess.
Exactly3configs ininitialwave. No unregistered tuning, ensembleweight adjustment, cherry-pickedseed or selective omission.
All devseasons are repeatedly reused; no untouched validationclaim and no correction can manufacture one. Count all priorwaves in disclosure.
Any change to candidate/target/info/resources/threshold after scoreinspection is a new protocol amendment/newwave; retain oldfailures and never overwrite oldresults.
Predeclare tie/order and selection. Inspect2025only afterselectedcandidate immutable; future datedprospective evidence is a separate later phase.
attribution: Matched screening holds managerpolicy andsolverprofile fixed; isolates forecast-system changes within declaredfeature/information differences.
Fullmanager andsensitivity runs test fullsystem trajectories. Alternative solverbudgets are paired forbaseline/candidate and reported separately, not extraindependentseasons.
Resourcecaps equalize permitted compute, not exact actual elapsedcost. Report observed costandfailed/abortedwork separately.
No claim that fullseason delta is isolated causal model effect; approximateoptimization and coupled futurestate can mediate it.

all candidate/baseline code/config/input/decision hashes consistent with preregistration

success_scope: A marked robust retrospective upgrade is a research milestone toward userwinninggoal; it does not prove anFPLwinner, futuregeneralization or rank-oneprobability.
execution_gate: Protocol locked before comparative outcomes. No decision job until complete independent actual-cache audit and immutable execution manifest cover all102 S1 origins and exact sources.
